FN-XJCDEZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 270
Committee: County & Municipal Government Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 04/08/2024
Senate Bill 270 as introduced could increase the administrative costs of certain public officers
by requiring all public records request to be acknowledged with a receipt of the request and to
provide the records in the manner prescribed by this bill.
